_about: Public-domain J. H. Jowett (John Henry Jowett, 1863-1923, Congregationalist, Carr's Lane, Birmingham, and Fifth Avenue Presbyterian, New York) for the Word Hoard, held to printings dated before 1930: Brooks by the Traveller's Way (1902), The Passion for Souls (1905), The Epistles of St. Peter (1910), Things That Matter Most (1913) and The Friend on the Road (1922) from CCEL; My Daily Meditation for the Circling Year (1914) and The Whole Armour of God (1916) from Project Gutenberg; and 14 more from Internet Archive scans, 1898-1925, among them From Strength to Strength, Apostolic Optimism, The Preacher: His Life and Work and The Eagle Life. Not Benjamin Jowett. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
